about: Files moved here byte for byte from another code tree by tools/move-code-between-trees: each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Only import paths and the listed calls differ.

the three index tests run over the record engine with agentRecordStore where the old built the whole person store; the fourteen activity and payment tests through that store are left out: old src/payment.mjs and the person store run nowhere.
